About Somdet Phra Nyanavajirodom(Phra Ajarn Luangphor Viriyang Sirintharo)

Somdet Phra Nyanavajirodom (Luang Phor Viriyang Sirintharo) was ordained as a novice monk on October 22, 1935, at the age of 15. He accompanied Phra Ajarn Kongma on meditation pilgrimages (tudong) to various places for a period of eight years.

During that time, he was fully ordained as a monk on May 20, 1941, at the age of 20. One day, Phra Ajarn Kongma led him on a pilgrimage where they met Phra Ajarn Mun Bhuridatta. Luang Phor Viriyang was chosen to serve as Phra Ajarn Mun’s attendant for four years during the rains retreats and five years outside the rains retreats, a total of nine years.

He practiced tudong and meditation alongside Phra Ajarn Mun, studying meditation and profound Dhamma. Later, he disseminated this meditation knowledge to the public through the Willpower Institute, which he founded on July 24, 1997, at Wat Dhammamongkol.

About our meditation courses

All Meditation Courses of the Willpower Institute Foundation are based on the teachings of Somdet Phra Nyanavajirodom Phra Ajarn Luang Phor Viriyang Sirintharo — the late and highly revered Thai Buddhist monk, Abbot of Wat Dhammamongkol, meditation master, and founder of the Willpower Institute Foundation.

The meditation methods originate from the direct lineage of his teacher, Luangpu Mun Bhuridatta, a renowned Vipassana meditation master in the Thai Forest monastic tradition.

The Willpower Institute Foundation aims to teach meditation with an emphasis on Samma-Samadhi (Right Meditation). Learning meditation and accumulating mind power bring great benefits and help cultivate virtues. Meditation promotes reason, responsibility, and loving-kindness. Those who practice meditation will experience benefits both physically and mentally.

FREE Online Meditation Instructor Course (6 Months) | MIC Online Batch 1, 2027

For the first time, the Willpower Institute Foundation is offering its English-language Meditation Instructor Course (MIC) online, so you can learn and practice wherever you live. Begin a lifelong journey towards inner peace, and help bring peace to the world.

MIC is based on the teachings of the late Somdet Phra Nyanavajirodom (Luangphor Viriyang Sirintharo), a renowned meditation master and founder of the Willpower Institute Foundation. It combines structured theory with systematic meditation practice.

How You Will Learn

Study the lectures on your own each day through an online learning platform, and practice walking and sitting meditation. Once a week, join a live online session with the instructors.

What You Will Gain

  • A step-by-step meditation practice
  • Inner peace and emotional balance
  • Personal virtues
  • The confidence to guide family, friends and others in meditation
  • A thorough understanding of meditation theory and practice

Who Is It For?

No prior meditation experience is required, and beginners are welcome.

  • People of all ages, genders, faiths and nationalities
  • Anyone with moderate English, including Thai participants
  • Those who have never enrolled in the Thai-language MIC (Kru Samadhi course)
  • Those in good mental health, with the patience and commitment to learn

Half-Day Yuvasa Samadhi (Meditation for Youth)

Yuvasa Samadhi is a free half-day English meditation program for youth. It is designed for children aged 6–11 in the morning and teens aged 12–15 in the afternoon who can communicate comfortably in English. Participants will learn both the theory and practice of meditation through engaging lessons and enjoyable activities.

7 Days Of Mind Power : English Meditation Retreat

The Willpower Institute Foundation invites you to a seven-day English-language meditation retreat at Wat Pa Dhampanomwan, surrounded by the peaceful natural environment of Wang Nam Khiao, Nakhon Ratchasima.

Designed as an introductory meditation retreat, the program provides participants with proper meditation techniques, structured guidance, and ample time for practice and reflection. No prior meditation experience is required.

Duration
17–24 December 2026
Location
Wat Pa Dhampanomwan, Wang Nam Khiao, Nakhon Ratchasima, Thailand
Early Registration Fee
THB 3,900 — register by 31 October 2026
Registration Deadline
30 November 2026, or earlier if all spaces are filled

The fee covers accommodation, meals, facility expenses, and round-trip coach transportation between Bangkok and the retreat venue.

The meditation training itself is provided free of charge. All instructors from the Willpower Institute Foundation volunteer their time and receive no teaching fees.

What You Will Experience

  • Daily meditation practice
  • Accessible teachings and guided learning
  • A supportive international retreat community
  • Time for quiet reflection and inner development
  • Simple temple living close to nature

Who Is It For?

The retreat is conducted in English and welcomes participants of all ages, genders, faiths, and backgrounds. No prior meditation experience is required, and beginners are welcome. The program offers a welcoming, meaningful, and structured environment while remaining true to Phra Ajarn Luangphor’s distinctive meditation teachings, presented in a practical and accessible format.

Enroll now - 30 November 2026 (or earlier if all spaces are filled)

This comprehensive six-month online meditation course is conducted in English and welcomes people of all nationalities and faiths, including Thai participants with English proficiency who have never enrolled in the Thai version of the course. *
Our weekly live online sessions are held on Saturday evenings from 19:30–21:00 and Sunday mornings from 10:00–11:30, Bangkok time (UTC+7). Please choose one as your primary session. You may attend the other session in weeks when you cannot attend your preferred one. *

Important information for Thai applicants

This course is intended for an English-speaking audience. We welcome both foreign and Thai applicants, but Thai participants must demonstrate proficiency in English. If you are already a graduate of Thai Kru Samadhi course, you are not eligible for this course, as the content is the same.

To demonstrate English proficiency, please provide as much background information as possible for our team to assess. If necessary, we will contact you to arrange a phone conversation with you. Your application will be evaluated on a case-by-case basis.

What is your native language? *
What is your English proficiency level? *

Native or Fluent – You can think, speak, and write in English with ease. You use complex language naturally, including idioms, slang, and cultural expressions.

Proficient – You understand nearly everything you hear or read, including long and complex discussions. You can express yourself spontaneously and precisely.

Intermediate – You can express yourself clearly and communicate well in everyday situations. However, more complex topics, such as technical, academic, or abstract subjects, may be challenging.

Since the content of the English MIC and the Thai version of the Kru-Samadhi course is the same, please confirm that you have not previously studied the Thai version of the Kru-Samadhi course. *
